# First Officer by UpNonStop

> First Officer is a rewards desk for business card spend: one conversation with First Officer across every loyalty program on the owner's file, working for the business owner. One flat plan at $550 a month. Award bookings are a separate $500 per itinerary. The Found Money Call is free and takes 20 minutes. US businesses only.

Plain facts, as stated on the site:

- Every connection is read-only. Nothing moves without the owner's yes; every transfer or booking waits for approval.
- Every Friday the owner gets a report with the dollar value of what was captured that week, est.
- No affiliate money from any bank, airline or hotel program, ever.
- No guaranteed savings. Every figure shown is an estimate, labelled est. Award space is set by each program and is not guaranteed.
- Not financial, tax or legal advice. The desk does not replace an accountant or financial advisor.
- UpNonStop, 235 Pavonia Avenue, Jersey City, NJ 07302. WhatsApp +1 619 940 4040.

- [Calculator · What is your spend really worth?](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/calculator.html): Run your own numbers. The calculator opens on an example gym, about 260k points a year today and about 750k est at the desk; pick your trade and move the sliders.
- [Trust | What we see, what we never touch](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/trust.html): Read-only connections, your approval first, no affiliate money and what we do not claim.
- [About · Why a desk, not another hack](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/about.html): Why First Officer exists, the rules we work by and the four pillars: Earn, Burn, Return, Learn.
- [Book the Found Money Call](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/book.html): Twenty minutes, free. See what your business card spend missed, against $550 a month.
- [Free from the desk · 595 free items for business owners](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/freebies.html): Everything I'd tell you over coffee: 595 smart items for business owners, free to read. Leave your email for the new ones.
- [Industries · 20 trades, one desk](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/industries.html): Your trade, your codes: 20 industries, each with an example monthly mix, the codes your vendors usually run under, and a calculator preset.
- [Field Notes | How the rewards game actually works](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/field-notes.html): Eight short notes on what a point is worth, cash back, timing, expiry and who card advice serves. Illustrative estimates.
- [Learn | Two minutes a week](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/education.html): Learn, the fourth pillar: one short lesson a week on what your points are worth. Illustrative estimates.
- [The floor most people settle for | Field note 02](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/cashback.html): Cash back is simple and safe, and often the least valuable use of a point you already earned, est.
- [Why it is this hard | Field note 03](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/complexity.html): Every layer of complexity moves a little value from your account to the program’s.
- [What quietly disappears | Field note 05](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/expiration.html): Points expire, credits reset and certificates lapse. None of it announces itself, and most of it is preventable.
- [Who the programs serve | Field note 06](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/loyalty.html): You are asked to be loyal to a program that can change its terms whenever it likes.
- [What actually works | Field note 08](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/proactive.html): Information you have to remember to go and look at is information you will not use.
- [When it has to happen | Field note 04](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/timing.html): Transfer bonuses, award releases and credit resets all run on clocks nobody publishes in one place.
- [What a point is worth | Field note 01](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/value.html): The same 50,000 points can be worth about $500 as cash back, or $2,500 to $4,000 toward a business-class trip, est. The balance tells you nothing until you know how it will be spent.
- [The Intelligence Report](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/upns.html): The Intelligence Report, every Saturday: transfer bonuses worth acting on, quiet repricings, and one save from a wallet like yours. Three dispatches to read in full.
- [The App](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/the-app.html): The First Officer app, coming soon: your desk in your pocket. The four pillars at a glance, your thread with the desk and the Friday count in dollars. Today the desk lives in one WhatsApp thread.
